training_inputs.quality: Only the authoritative train-fit shard: 55 grouped requests and 132300 token-layer rows.
training_inputs.long: Both authoritative long-trace shards remain together in training and are assigned synthetic group identities distinct from quality requests.
training_inputs.forbidden: The precision-diagnostic, calibration, and test archives may not contribute fitting, hyperparameter selection, stopping, or feature statistics.

feature_transform.hidden: Decode the frozen symmetric groupwise int4 gate-input feature with its per-32-value FP16 scales into FP16 training batches; retain the five-case FP32/FP16 diagnostic for the later frozen precision check.
feature_transform.causal_history: For each source row t, form a 256-way vector from selected experts at t,t-1,t-2,t-3 in the same request and layer, weighted 1,1/2,1/4,1/8. Missing causal positions are zero and no request/layer boundary may be crossed.

probe.scope: One independent head per routed layer, with a shared selected rank across layers.
probe.architecture: bias-free Linear(6400,rank), GELU, Linear(rank,768) with output slices ordered K=2,K=4,K=8 and expert ID ascending
probe.loss: Mean over K of request-balanced BCEWithLogits. Within each training fold and K, positive weight is (256-mean target cardinality)/mean target cardinality, derived only from that fold's fitting rows.
probe.numeric_mode: FP16 CUDA autocast for matrix operations with FP32 master parameters, optimizer state, and loss accumulation; non-finite input, gradient, parameter, or score is FAIL.

cross_validation.group_assignment: sha256('glm52-p1-fold-v1\0' + authoritative_group_id) interpreted big-endian modulo 3; both long requests share one authoritative lineage group and therefore one fold.
cross_validation.aggregation: For each K/budget cell, arithmetic mean within each validation request and then an unweighted arithmetic mean across validation requests; concatenate out-of-fold request results before the final macro mean.
cross_validation.rank_selection: Choose the rank with the highest K=4,budget=32 macro-request recall; an exact tie selects the smaller rank. No other metric or split may change the choice.
cross_validation.final_epochs: Eight fixed epochs on all authorized training rows after rank selection; no held-out early stopping.

baselines.frequency: Per-layer selected-expert counts from each fitting fold only; descending count with ascending expert ID for ties.
baselines.gate_replay: Exact full 256-expert current-state effective-router ordering. The existing top-32 compact view is insufficient for budget 64; derive and hash-bind the full ordering from retained raw router probability and bias tensors before any comparison.
baselines.two_step_shared_correction: Measured separately from a frozen engine/capture path because the compact gate input does not contain the shared-expert residual needed to recompute the next router.
baselines.mtp_rollout: Measured separately from a frozen MTP capture path; do not approximate it from accepted token IDs or frequency.

resource_policy.execution: Load only authorized archives, train one layer/rank/fold at a time, release CUDA tensors between fits, and stop on any allocator error, OOM indicator, Xid, or non-finite value.

selection_claim_limit: Train-only cross-validation selects a candidate but cannot establish held-out improvement. Calibration remains reserved for P2. Test is opened once only after the probe, exact baselines, scorer, hashes, and output format are frozen.
